steps.text: 这是棋盘。先把包放上去，包占住的格子才放得下东西。

texts.en: This is the Board. Put a bag on it first; you can only place things on cells a bag covers.

steps.text: 拿起一件，按 R 转一格；拿着的时候点右键，放回原处。

texts.en: Pick something up and press R to rotate it. Right-click while holding it to put it back.

steps.text: 双击一件，在棋盘和地上之间快速挪；直接拖到棋盘外面，也是放到地上。

texts.en: Double-click an item to move it between the Board and the Ground. Dragging it off the Board also drops it on the Ground.

steps.text: 底下三枚火漆签：耐力档、估算输出、负重 —— 这几张图不限重，正式进去才算。

texts.en: The three wax seals at the bottom: stamina band, est. damage, Load. These maps have no weight limit; it only counts once you go in for real.
